name: Feather ESP32-S3 FeatherWing OLED 128x32 Demo
description: Tests the Adafruit FeatherWing OLED 128x32 (SSD1306, Adafruit #2900) stacked on an Adafruit Feather ESP32-S3. Responds to checkin, configures the SSD1306 at I2C address 0x3C on the Feather S3 primary Wire bus (SDA=GPIO3, SCL=GPIO4), writes test messages, then verifies repeat writes.

steps.name: checkin-response
steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and Feather ESP32-S3 board capabilities

steps.name: add-display
steps.description: Configure the 128x32 SSD1306 OLED FeatherWing via I2C at address 0x3C. SDA=GPIO3, SCL=GPIO4 (Feather ESP32-S3 primary Wire bus).

steps.name: write-hello
steps.description: Write a multi-line test message after the display add succeeds

write.name: oled128x32default
write.message:
Hello from ProtoMQ!
Feather ESP32-S3
128x32 I2C OLED

steps.name: write-update
steps.description: Write a second message to verify repeat writes work (no driver hang)

steps.name: write-status
steps.description: Final pass/fail status message for camera verification

write.name: oled128x32default
write.message:
PASS: OLED OK
WipperSnapper
display test
